note: The street scenes. Drawn from real city blocks by Location Scout (https://tools.oyasumi-gamedev.com/rokehan/), which builds a block of a city from OpenStreetMap and elevation data and draws it as a manga background in line art and screentone. The house's own figures are pasted into the streets, so the same girl appears in a different place on a different page.
credit: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Elevation: Terrain Tiles · Surroundings: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles. The credit is also burned into the bottom of every served picture.
